abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.shortEffect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.

abilities.name: Supersweet Syrup
abilities.shortEffect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
abilities.effect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord
abilities.shortEffect: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
abilities.effect: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.
abilities.effect: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles Speed during rain.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

abilities.name: Sword of Ruin
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.shortEffect: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
abilities.effect: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.shortEffect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

abilities.name: Tablets of Ruin
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles evasion when confused.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.

abilities.name: Tangling Hair
abilities.shortEffect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.

abilities.name: Tera Shell
abilities.shortEffect: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

abilities.name: Tera Shift
abilities.shortEffect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

abilities.name: Teraform Zero
abilities.shortEffect: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.
abilities.effect: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

abilities.name: Teravolt
abilities.shortEffect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Turboblaze.

abilities.name: Thermal Exchange
abilities.shortEffect: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.
abilities.effect: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.shortEffect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

abilities.name: Tinted Lens
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

abilities.name: Toxic Boost
abilities.shortEffect: Increases Attack to 1.5× when poisoned.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Attack when poisoned.

abilities.name: Toxic Chain
abilities.shortEffect: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

abilities.name: Toxic Debris
abilities.shortEffect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
abilities.effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.shortEffect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

abilities.name: Transistor
abilities.shortEffect: Powers up Electric-type moves.
abilities.effect: Increases the power of Electric-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

abilities.name: Triage
abilities.shortEffect: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

abilities.name: Truant
abilities.shortEffect: Skips every second turn.
abilities.effect: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

abilities.name: Turboblaze
abilities.shortEffect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Teravolt.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.shortEffect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
abilities.effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.

abilities.name: Unseen Fist
abilities.shortEffect: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.
abilities.effect: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

abilities.name: Vessel of Ruin
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.shortEffect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.
abilities.effect: All friendly Pokémon's moves, including this Pokémon's own moves, have 1.1× their usual accuracy while this Pokémon is in battle.

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents sleep.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.shortEffect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.effect: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

abilities.name: Wandering Spirit
abilities.shortEffect: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.
abilities.effect: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.shortEffect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.effect: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.shortEffect: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.

abilities.name: Water Compaction
abilities.shortEffect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
abilities.effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents burns.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.shortEffect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
abilities.effect: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.shortEffect: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.
abilities.effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

abilities.name: Wimp Out
abilities.shortEffect: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
abilities.effect: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.

abilities.name: Wind Power
abilities.shortEffect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
abilities.effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Wind Rider
abilities.shortEffect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.
abilities.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

abilities.name: Wonder Guard
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.

abilities.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
abilities.effect: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Zen Mode
abilities.shortEffect: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.
abilities.effect: This Pokémon switches between Standard Mode and Zen Mode after each turn depending on its HP. Below 50% of its maximum HP, it switches to Zen Mode, and at 50% or above, it switches to Standard Mode. This Pokémon returns to Standard Mode upon leaving battle or losing this ability. This ability has no effect if this Pokémon is not a Darmanitan.

abilities.name: Zero to Hero
abilities.shortEffect: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
abilities.effect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

abilities.name: Aura Guard
abilities.shortEffect: Halves damage taken from contact moves.
abilities.effect: Halves damage received from moves that make contact.
